Phobos.Framework.Setup.PhobosSetupPageDe.label: D'thorga Radio Framework
Phobos.Framework.Setup.PhobosSetupPageDe.description: Radio that works like radio: base stations, hand-helds and relay masts, where distance, height, walls and hills decide who can hear whom. Colonists chat, give advice, call other factions and keep in touch with convoys away from home.

li.label: Gentler
li.description: Nobody ambushes a trader you call for, jammers leave radios alone, and relay masts never wear out or get knocked down.

li.label: Standard
li.description: A hostile settlement that hears you call a trader may ambush it, and a jammer's noise drowns radios near it, yours too. Relay masts left on the world map stay standing.

li.label: Harsher
li.description: As Standard, and relay masts left on the world map wear out and can be knocked down by raiders.
